visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video utilizes a split-screen format. The upper frame shows a young woman with short dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt, looking down. The lower frame shows a smartphone screen displaying a bedroom scene with a pink floral bedsheet. A ginger cat's tail is visible. (2) An orange tabby cat enters the lower frame, nudging the side of the smartphone with its head. The woman’s right hand enters the bottom view to pet the cat's neck while her other hand holds the device. The background shows a wooden floor and domestic furniture. (3) The cat continues to push its nose and forehead against the phone, causing the camera angle in the bottom frame to shift slightly. Bright, natural indoor lighting illuminates the scene. The woman looks toward the camera in the top frame with a curious expression. (4) The woman brings a small black comb into the lower frame, gently scratching the top of the cat's head. The cat stands still, looking directly into the lens of the smartphone. The bed area remains messy with rumpled blankets and pillows. (5) Red graphic symbols depicting anger appear above the cat's head as it paws at the phone. The woman moves the device closer to the cat's face for a tight close-up. The cat appears mildly frustrated, shifting its body away from the direct contact. (6) The cat shifts its mood and begins rubbing its cheek affectionately against the edge of the phone. Pink heart-shaped animations float upwards from the bottom of the screen. The woman keeps her hand resting on the cat's back as the scene ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video captures a humorous and relatable everyday moment of a pet owner being distracted by their cat. Using a split-screen perspective to show both the owner's face and the cat's 'POV' on the phone, the content highlights the cat's persistent attempts to gain attention, ultimately ending in a sweet moment of affection to engage and amuse animal lovers.
